items.question: Is Tanisha Wright the Penn State coach?
items.answer: Yes. Penn State named Tanisha Wright head coach of its women's basketball team on March 19, 2026. She played for Penn State from 2001 to 2005 and is the program's seventh head coach.

items.question: Which WNBA teams did Tanisha Wright play for?
items.answer: Tanisha Wright played 14 WNBA seasons, from 2005 to 2019: 10 with the Seattle Storm, three with the New York Liberty and one with the Minnesota Lynx. She won the 2010 WNBA championship with Seattle.

items.question: Did Tanisha Wright coach the Chicago Sky?
items.answer: Yes. Tanisha Wright was an assistant coach for the Chicago Sky in 2025 before Penn State hired her as head coach.

items.question: How did Tanisha Wright do as Atlanta Dream coach?
items.answer: Tanisha Wright was head coach of the Atlanta Dream from 2022 through 2024. She was named AP Coach of the Year in 2022 and led Atlanta to back-to-back playoff appearances in 2023 and 2024. The Dream parted ways with her in October 2024.

items.question: What were Tanisha Wright's WNBA career averages?
items.answer: Tanisha Wright averaged 7.3 points, 2.6 rebounds and 3.1 assists in 457 WNBA regular-season games. She made the WNBA All-Defensive First Team five times with Seattle.

items.question: How old is Tanisha Wright?
items.answer: Tanisha Wright was born November 29, 1983. She grew up in West Mifflin, Pennsylvania.
